source.author: verg
source.text: Omne aevum ferro teritur, versaque iuvencum terga fatigamus hasta; nec tarda senectus debilitat vires animi mutatque vigorem:
source.text_original: Omne aevum ferro teritur, versaque iuvencum / terga fatigamus hasta; nec tarda senectus / debilitat vires animi mutatque vigorem: /
source.text_english: All time is worn away by the sword, and we wear out the backs of cattle with our turned spear; nor does slow old age weaken the strength of our spirit or change its vigor:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: hic soror Aeoliden aevum mansura per omne deserit, heu saevae nequiquam erepta novercae.
reuse.text_original: hic soror Aeoliden aevum mansura per omne / deserit, heu saevae nequiquam erepta novercae.
reuse.text_english: Here the sister leaves the Aeolid, to remain through all time, alas, snatched in vain from her cruel stepmother.
